title: Senior Key Account Manager (E-commerce)

Content management & optimization
Campaign strategies & execution

The position monitors host delivery, content compliance, and audience engagement in real time, provides feedback to optimize live sessions, manages the live chat experience, and prepares post-live performance reports while ensuring hosts communicate product USPs and brand messaging accurately.

As an Livestream QC Specialist, you will take charge of
